feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact D3A5 parent to C993 central object 0x570002 only; preserve CABE outer halo, SkyGlow, other HUD, original game Draw, FFB/input and separate DX11/DXVK branches.
trace_stages: Exact original EXE D3A5 central source and C993 object owner with reentrant call epoch.
Raw game WVP c64 setter records direct producer, original shader epoch and corresponding original parent epoch.
Actual packaged R26+HUD renderer reconstructs world per-eye correction only from call-proven original c64, else lower draw fallback.

Use same-call, original shader, draw-age and queue-free proof for the actual packaged R26+HUD world-eye stereo.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R26+HUD R30 WorldBillboard fallback reads live c64 after the owned raw 12-draw window; original c64 recorder captured queue producer only, so C993 direct owner was lost.
source_trace: D3A5 call pairs with D3AA around sub_40C980 and exact C993 draw of 0x570002.
Source raw WVP upload recorded shader and scope but only queue producer token.
R30 WorldBillboard per-eye WorldView rebuild could reread live GPU c64 after earlier eye injection.
diagnosis.root_cause: Exact central call identity was missing from original WVP provenance, allowing unrelated recent/same shader c64 or live already-injected c64 to be treated as a fresh central-sun world transform.
alternatives_rejected: Do not install duplicate C993 hook or modify outer CABE halo geometry.
Increasing raw c64 age alone lacks object provenance; alpha state is not centre identity.
Do not globally suppress effects, flush unrelated D3DX or alter VR head pose.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: D3A5 parent epoch/direct producer captured at original c64 write; packaged R30 validates source epoch, producer, queue/shader/draw and consumes raw c64 only.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: 11 C++ constexpr positive/negative test conditions compile with packaged R26+HUD owner at identical SHA.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Proven raw original WorldView receives the existing single head inverse and per-eye transform; unproven raw falls to existing lower original raster route.
